info.description: Product Core (Workstream 1) and meeting-platform integrations (Workstream 2) API. All endpoints are under /api/v1.

get.description:
Meeting history: database-backed pagination, restricted to projects
the caller may view at summary level.

delete.description: Soft delete; content is hard-deleted by the retention job after a grace period.

get.description: Export the meeting record (metadata, transcript, translations). Requires transcript access.

schema.title: Response List Imports Api V1 Meetings  Meeting Id  Transcript Imports Get

patch.description:
Correct the source transcript (e.g. recognition errors). The first
original wording is preserved in source_metadata for traceability, and
AI translations of the entry are reset so they are regenerated.

put.description: User correction of a translation. Stored separately; the source text is untouched.

post.description:
Replay a transcript incrementally through the connector ingestion path.
DEMO MODE: this is not a live meeting connection.
